methods.primary_parser: Original process_df_for_isproblematic: str(value).lower().strip(), then substring 'problematic'; no change to original behaviour
methods.correlation_parser: Original correlation code: raw string equals exactly 'Acceptable' gives1, every other raw spelling gives0, even trailing-space/lowercase acceptable. Pearson on222 inner-joined exact PatientQuestion keys; unique keys/complete4-way matching required.
methods.agreement_parser: Original pivot aggfunc first, after proving each question/model unique; literal 'Acceptable' and literal 'Problematic' all4. No normalization in credited branch.
methods.issues: Original plot counts nonblank after whitespace-only replacement; statistical branch counts pandas notna before replacement. Source schema shows no whitespace-only cells, so these branches coincide without repair. Original newline-tag value remains nonblank and counted. No nesting-based filtering.
methods.ratings: Preserve all exact numeric ratings including original fractional scores; no truncation or recoding. Means and sample SD ddof1 as original Seaborn/pandas source.
methods.omnibus_proportions: Original scipy chi2_contingency4x2,df3,default correction (Yates only applied atdf1,thus none); compute all6 proportion omnibus tests and retain expected-cell tables. Require every expected cell>=5 as original asserted method validity; do not switch tests.
methods.pairwise_proportions: Original statsmodels defaulttwo-sided pooled two-proportion z-test, no continuity correction; Bonferroni factor6 and clipping1 separately within each family, never across all issues. Preserve original p<.05 omnibus trigger for published posthoc dispatch. Compute additional12 unreported issue pairwise results only as supporting diagnostic, clearly tagged not originally dispatched.
methods.kruskal: Original pooled average ranks, tie-corrected Kruskal-Wallis H,chi-square df3 survival p; all888 values and all4 groups
methods.dunn: Original scikit_posthocs Dunn average-rank difference divided by sqrt((N(N+1)/12-sum(t^3-t)/(12(N-1)))*(1/n_i+1/n_j)); two-sided normal tail; all6 Bonferroni factor6, clipped1
methods.implementation_plan: Independent paper-method Python implementation using installed pandas/numpy/scipy and explicit equivalent formulas for absent scikit_posthocs/statsmodels. Archived named-package source versions are formula references, not claims of historical authors package versions. Original authors code is not imported/executed during preparation.
methods.independent_audit: Second parser from raw XLSX ZIP/XML shared-string/cell sources, independent Python collections/math formulas and hand-built pooled average ranks; validate every original row/value/string, all source/input/output hashes, all numerical families and all141 mandatory gates; do not import analysis code or borrow aggregates.
methods.paired_design_diagnostic: Because the same physician rates all4 responses to a question but original inferential tests treat cohorts independently, additionally report prespecified exact two-sided paired McNemar for primary+all5 issues (all36 pairs, Bonferroni6 within family) and4-model Friedman for numeric ratings as supporting analyses only. Missing rater identities prevent evaluator-cluster sensitivity. Diagnostic conclusions can never replace failed original gates.
methods.normalized_label_diagnostic: Separately compute normalized main-parser binary Pearson and normalized unanimous counts/question sets, list affected raw spellings/UUIDs. Original exact-literal results remain the only credited correlation/agreement branch.
methods.uncertainty: Reproduce all published SDs and inferential p-values. Supporting Wilson95percent intervals for4 primary+20 issue proportions with fixed z=1.959963984540054; no new CIs presented as publication uncertainty.
methods.randomness: All statistical methods deterministic. No outcome-dependent seeds/variants/tolerances. No bootstrap needed.

gate_policy: Every mandatory target must pass, plus zero missing/invalid primary values and complete source-integrity audit. No passing-subset credit or rescue by normalized/paired diagnostics. Numerical tolerance is half displayed rounding unit; threshold inequalities exact. Only Figure3 uses fixed0.15 percentage-point raster-digitation tolerance. Floating comparison allowance is relative1e-12 times stated tolerance, never an extra fixed wide absolute epsilon. All reported failures remain immutable.
